description.value: Trees Cheesecake & Organic Coffee has been a Vancouver institution since 1996, roasting small-batch organic beans in-house and pairing them with award-winning homemade cheesecakes made fresh daily in rotating flavours. The Burrard Street location is one of roughly 13–14 Vancouver cafes operated as a mix of corporate and franchised outlets. Cyclists stopping here can expect a full cafe menu of sandwiches, baked goods, teas, and cold drinks alongside the signature coffee and cheesecake.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms this is an active multi-location Vancouver coffee chain (branded 'Trees Cheesecake & Organic Coffee'), and the OSM branch tag 'Burrard' directly matches one of the named locations listed on the About page. Takeout is confirmed by explicit 'Online Order' and 'In-Store Pickup & Delivery' links throughout the site. Neither the website nor OSM tags mention bike parking, washrooms, water refill, Wi-Fi, or device charging for any specific location, so those remain null.
concerns: Name mismatch: OSM records 'Trees Organic Coffee' but the website consistently uses 'Trees Cheesecake & Organic Coffee' as the primary brand name.
Location count inconsistency on the website: About page states 13 locations while the front page states 14.
The OSM phone (+1-604-732-0092) does not appear on the website; a different number (604.684.5060) is listed only for catering orders — main location phone unconfirmed.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Active, publicly accessible Vancouver cafe with a well-maintained website and a recent OSM check date of 2025-11-27; a useful refreshment stop for touring cyclists.
